title: GEO-PTBR: a Brazilian-Portuguese replication of Generative Engine Optimization
description:
Replication of the nine GEO content-side optimization techniques (Aggarwal et al., arXiv:2311.09735) on a 525-query Brazilian-Portuguese benchmark, measured across three generative engines. Includes the benchmark, the measurement pipeline, the compiled paper, and the per-engine and cross-engine results with bootstrap confidence intervals.

Code is MIT-licensed; data and paper are CC BY 4.0. Canonical dataset copy: https://huggingface.co/datasets/epicchi2103/geo-ptbr — source repository: https://github.com/epicchiotti2103/geo-ptbr
